Name: MAP_GD_REGION_ID_PARAM_ST
Description: Region ID of each map. Row ID: map mAA_BB_CC_DD as AA·1,000,000 + BB·10,000 + CC·100, plus DD for overworld tiles. On an overworld tile the parent 512 m and 1024 m tiles are tried next; the first row found decides.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Parameters marked with  are excluded in the NT version package.

Fields.Name: Region ID
Fields.Description: Region this map belongs to. Weather first looks up WeatherParam row Region ID × 100 + weather type and falls back to the plain weather type row (e.g. region 20, weather 20 → WeatherParam 2020). MapGdRegionDrawParam rows use the same IDs.
